stops.name: Mühlviertel
stops.detail: Between the Danube in the south and the Bohemian Forest in the north sits the Mühlviertel. The rivers Große Mühl and the Kleine Mühl, after which the Upper Austrian region is named, meander powerfully through the landscapes – both tributaries of the Danube.
